name: Restoration Live Transfers

hero.headline: Restoration Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for restoration solutions.

overview: Restoration Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect property owners recovering from fire, smoke, mould, storm and water events with full-service restoration contractors.

Live Transfers help restoration contractors allocate project managers to the losses that matter most. Our team confirms the property location, ownership or management authority, type and extent of the loss, property type and insurance claim status before warm-transferring the call. This screening separates full-scope insured losses from small self-pay jobs, routes mould inquiries to certified remediation teams and identifies commercial properties that require different handling. Intake staff receive a well-documented handoff and can schedule an assessment with confidence that the project fits the contractor's capabilities.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of restoration consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners, landlords, HOAs and commercial property managers dealing with a recent property loss that requires professional remediation and rebuilding. The most valuable segments are insured fire and major water losses that include reconstruction, mould remediation cases discovered during a sale or renovation, and multi-property owners affected by a regional storm event.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for fire damage restoration, mould remediation or restoration company near me; recent house fire, kitchen fire or smoke event in the property; visible mould growth or a failed mould inspection during a home sale; storm, tornado, hurricane or wildfire damage in the area.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "restoration company near me" and "fire damage restoration", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard restoration criteria include: property located within the contractor's service area; owner, property manager or authorised representative of the property; type of loss identified as fire, smoke, mould, storm, water or biohazard; residential or commercial property type confirmed; insurance claim status established, whether filed, approved or self-pay; ready to schedule an on-site assessment or estimate.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can programs focus on specific loss types such as fire or mould?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns and screening can be configured around fire and smoke, mould remediation, storm damage or reconstruction, individually or in combination.

faq.q: Can restoration calls be activated after a regional disaster?
faq.a: Response campaigns can be deployed in affected areas within days of a storm or wildfire event, with screening tuned to the type of damage that occurred.

faq.q: Do you distinguish insured from self-pay losses?
faq.a: Insurance claim status is captured during screening so that you can prioritise insured, full-scope projects or accept self-pay work according to your business model.
